$comment: Claude Code runtime settings for Norm. The prompt is portable/claude-code/agents/norm.md; this file is the configuration that has no business inside a prompt. Read agents/norm/PORTING.md before wiring it up.
$toolsComment: Write and Edit are present, unlike Barb, because editing the skills IS his work — the two agents are deliberate opposites and neither tool list should drift toward the other. What keeps him safe is not the absence of a write tool but the absence of a merge: he writes to a branch in his own checkout and a person decides. Narrow Bash to git and the forge API if your setup allows; he needs nothing else.
$modelComment: sonnet. The work is small, careful edits to existing prose in a voice he has to match, plus the judgment of when a note is an undecided question rather than a rule — worth more than a small model and less than the reviewer's fan-out, which is where confident wrong findings are expensive. Raise it if he starts drafting rule text rather than carrying somebody else's evidence into it.
$mergeComment: There is no configuration here that prevents a merge, and there cannot be — a merge is a forge permission, not a tool. Give his credential write access to contents and pull requests and nothing more. The prompt says he never merges; the token is what makes that true.
